summary: Configure CI to report coverage only on PR-diff lines, gate merges per-file on a default 80% threshold, and publish a trend dashboard — replacing whole-repo coverage as the team's primary metric.

assumes_loaded.why: Diff coverage answers "did you test the new code"; AC mapping answers "did you test the right behaviour".
The risk matrix drives per-file threshold overrides (higher in billing, lower in scripts).
What diff coverage cannot catch — exploratory sessions cover that gap.
